angles.drive: You measure yourself against yourself, and nobody else gets a vote. More Metal is in you than a day spends, and the rest holds your shape. You keep the standard and trust only yourself, or you let it slip and learn who else you could. The cost is that nobody gets close enough to count.

Letting people in stopped being something you decline and became something you cannot quite locate. Fine, you say, on the day of the diagnosis, the layoff, the breakup. The word has three hundred uses now, and not one of them means fine.
